mobbin:74bc6276-56b0-44b9-9a2b-cd8ed27f6.summary: From the event home, the host opens Check In Guests, scans a guest QR, confirms Check In, sees success with Undo, then verifies the guest on the Guest List (and an empty Invited tab).
steps: Check In Successful toast (still on scan)
steal: Primary Check In Guests action on the session/event home (step 1) — puts tagging before any recording UI.
Confirm sheet after scan: name, email, Going status, Registered time, then explicit Check In (step 3) — prevents wrong-person tagging.
Immediate Undo Check In on the success sheet (step 5) — mistake recovery without leaving the scanner loop.
List icon escape hatch on the scanner (steps 2/4/6) — QR-first with one-tap fallback to the guest list.
avoid: Empty Invited tab with only 'No Guests' (step 8) adds little for sim rooms — prefer a single expected/present split over RSVP-style tabs.
mobbin:74bc6276-56b0-44b9-9a2b-cd8ed27f6.fit: Adds room/session QR check-in outside the SRV (who-is-here that can label/trigger recording); feeds learner names into SRV transcript/Annotation instead of Speaker #N — no face ID.

mobbin:cd3469d9-df14-4fa5-8003-021c7055a.summary: From the guest list with Going / Checked In / Not Checked In counts, the host opens a guest card, taps Check In, sees a success toast and list badge, then can Undo with an audit line of who checked them in.
steps: Guest list — Going / Checked In counts + List|Scan
Success toast — guest Checked In Now
Guest card — Undo Check In + by-whom audit
steal: Going / Checked In / Not Checked In count chips (step 1) — at-a-glance room readiness for operators.
List | Scan toggle in the bottom bar (step 1) — same roster, two input modes without leaving context.
Relative check-in time ('Now', '19 min ago') on the row badge (steps 1/3) — who just arrived.
Audit line 'Checked In · By Sam Lee' with Undo (step 4) — multi-operator accountability and correction.
avoid: Social/bio chrome and referrer metadata on the guest card (steps 2/4) — noise for faculty; keep identity + roster status only.
mobbin:cd3469d9-df14-4fa5-8003-021c7055a.fit: Replaces ad-hoc name entry before/beside SRV with a per-room roster + List|Scan check-in; Checked In set becomes the session's participant tag list on the recording.
